C0608.title: User Buys Recycled Phone Number, Receives Debt Collection Messages and Calls for a Year
C0608.summary: In May 2022, a user on the C114 forum reported that a newly activated mobile number was a recycled one, and they had been receiving various debt collection messages and calls for over a year without interruption. The number was reissued by the carrier after the previous owner defaulted or canceled the account, making it unusable for the new owner and severely disrupting daily communications.

references.title: Troubles from Carriers' Second Number Release May Have Outweighed Benefits - Tencent News
